title: Disclosure Day trailer said '7 billion' but the film says '8 billion'

tellings.quote: that came out, the line in the trailer was 7 billion people have the right to know the truth?

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels, discussing a Hollywood film called Disclosure Day about the world learning the truth about aliens, pointed to a small change. He says the trailer's line was that 7 billion people have the right to know the truth, while the film itself says 8 billion, a detail he raises, citing writer Bryce Zabel, as worth noticing in how the story was put together.
